message.text: Searching for API-layer handlers that call Store.CreateMemo.
I'll search recursively for Store.CreateMemo to identify the calling API-layer handlers.

APIV1Service.CreateMemo in server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go is the only API-layer handler that directly calls Store.CreateMemo. CreateMemoComment invokes the RPC handler s.CreateMemo, which then calls Store.CreateMemo.

q11.
APIV1Service.CreateMemo — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go

That method is the only API handler that invokes `s.Store.CreateMemo`. `APIV1Service.CreateMemoComment` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` calls `s.CreateMemo` (the RPC handler), not `Store.CreateMemo` directly.
